page.layout: One page of text, running head at top, page number above the head. No notes in the printed margins of this page. The strip at the left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Signature "F 2" and catchword "pius" at the foot.

main_text.p: ca.17. allegat exemplum Constantini, & refert verba ex literis ejus ad alium vicarium, ubi Constantinus testatur se inter partes cognovisse & innocentem Coelianū comperisse. Idē Augustinus in opere breviculo collationum cum Donatistis, sub initiū et finem, di-cit; quòd catholici episcopi & Donatistæ, jussu imperatoris inter se gestis apud tribunum & notarium Marcellinum habitis contulerint: diserte item ꝓfitetur[?], quòd ingres-sis utrisq; partibus, primo loco re-citatum sit rescriptū Imperatoris, quo jussit collationē inter episcopos fieri: deinde secundo loco etiam recitatum sit edictum ipsius cognitoris, quod per provinciam miserat, ut convenirent utriusq; partis episcopi, & intra diem calendarum Juniarū conferendi causa congregarentur Carthagine. Præterea dicit, quòd ex consilio & moderamine Marcellini omnia fuerint in-stituta & gesta; quod idem ille sæ-

page.notes: The running head is in italic. "ca.17." at the start of the first line is a reference set in the text column and is transcribed inline. "ꝓfitetur" is doubtful: the abbreviation mark is hard to read, so [?] is added. "ingres-sis" at the line end is read as "sis" with some doubt. Italic runs from "Idē" to "dicit;". The page ends mid-word ("sæ-") and the catchword "pius" begins the next page.
